Newton's Second Law.name: Newton's Second Law
Newton's Second Law.law: Force equals mass times acceleration — the fundamental relation between cause (force) and effect (acceleration) in the Natural Domain

Kinetic Energy.name: Kinetic Energy
Kinetic Energy.law: Energy of motion — a state of the entity determined by its mass and velocity

Potential Energy (gravitational).name: Potential Energy (gravitational)
Potential Energy (gravitational).law: Energy stored in position within a gravitational field

Work-Energy Theorem.name: Work-Energy Theorem
Work-Energy Theorem.law: Work done equals force times displacement in the direction of force

Conservation of Energy.name: Conservation of Energy
Conservation of Energy.law: Total energy is conserved — a state that cannot be destroyed, only transformed

Momentum.name: Momentum
Momentum.law: Quantity of motion — a state of entity determined by mass and velocity

Conservation of Momentum.name: Conservation of Momentum
Conservation of Momentum.law: Total momentum is conserved in an isolated system

Uniform Motion.name: Uniform Motion
Uniform Motion.law: Distance equals velocity times time — the discretization of continuous motion into finite steps

Equation of Motion.name: Equation of Motion
Equation of Motion.law: Velocity changes linearly with time under constant acceleration

Gravitational Force.name: Gravitational Force
Gravitational Force.law: Gravitational attraction between masses — inverse square law

Orbital Velocity.name: Orbital Velocity
Orbital Velocity.law: Speed required for circular orbit — balance of gravitational and centripetal force

Ideal Gas Law.name: Ideal Gas Law
Ideal Gas Law.law: State equation of an ideal gas — pressure, volume, and temperature are mutually constraining

First Law of Thermodynamics.name: First Law of Thermodynamics
First Law of Thermodynamics.law: Energy is conserved: internal energy change equals heat added minus work done

Entropy Change.name: Entropy Change
Entropy Change.law: Entropy measures disorder — heat at temperature T changes entropy by Q/T

Boltzmann Entropy.name: Boltzmann Entropy
Boltzmann Entropy.law: Statistical definition of entropy — connects macroscopic state to microscopic counting

Stefan-Boltzmann Law.name: Stefan-Boltzmann Law
Stefan-Boltzmann Law.law: Radiated power proportional to fourth power of temperature

Coulomb's Law.name: Coulomb's Law
Coulomb's Law.law: Electric force between charges — same structure as gravitational law

Electric Field.name: Electric Field
Electric Field.law: Electric field is force per unit charge at a point in space

Ohm's Law.name: Ohm's Law
Ohm's Law.law: Voltage equals current times resistance — linear relation between cause (voltage) and effect (current)

Electric Power.name: Electric Power
Electric Power.law: Power dissipated in a circuit — three equivalent forms

Capacitance.name: Capacitance
Capacitance.law: Capacity to store charge per unit voltage

Magnetic Force.name: Magnetic Force
Magnetic Force.law: Force on a moving charge in a magnetic field — cross product relation

Faraday's Law.name: Faraday's Law
Faraday's Law.law: Changing magnetic flux induces EMF — the basis of electromagnetic induction

Maxwell's Equation (Gauss).name: Maxwell's Equation (Gauss)
Maxwell's Equation (Gauss).law: Total electric flux through closed surface equals enclosed charge

Planck-Einstein Relation.name: Planck-Einstein Relation
Planck-Einstein Relation.law: Energy of a photon — the bridge between wave (frequency) and particle (energy) descriptions

de Broglie Wavelength.name: de Broglie Wavelength
de Broglie Wavelength.law: Every particle has an associated wavelength — wave-particle duality Law

Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle.name: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle
Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle.law: Position and momentum cannot be simultaneously known with arbitrary precision

Schrödinger Equation (time-dependent).name: Schrödinger Equation (time-dependent)
Schrödinger Equation (time-dependent).law: Evolution of quantum state in time — the Laws of quantum dynamics

Energy Levels (hydrogen).name: Energy Levels (hydrogen)
Energy Levels (hydrogen).law: Discrete energy states of hydrogen atom — first quantized energy spectrum

Photoelectric Effect.name: Photoelectric Effect
Photoelectric Effect.law: Photon ejects electron if its energy exceeds the work function

Mass-Energy Equivalence.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
Mass-Energy Equivalence.law: Mass and energy are equivalent — the most famous Law in physics

Time Dilation.name: Time Dilation
Time Dilation.law: Moving clocks run slower — time is relative to the observer

Length Contraction.name: Length Contraction
Length Contraction.law: Moving objects appear shorter in the direction of motion

Relativistic Energy.name: Relativistic Energy
Relativistic Energy.law: General energy-momentum relation — E=mc² is the special case p=0

Lorentz Factor.name: Lorentz Factor
Lorentz Factor.law: Scale factor for relativistic effects — diverges as v→c

Pythagorean Theorem.name: Pythagorean Theorem
Pythagorean Theorem.law: Fundamental relation in Euclidean geometry — discovered, not invented

Euler's Formula.name: Euler's Formula
Euler's Formula.law: The most beautiful formula — connects e, π, i, cos, sin in one expression

Euler's Identity.name: Euler's Identity
Euler's Identity.law: Five fundamental constants unified — often called the most beautiful equation

Taylor Series.name: Taylor Series
Taylor Series.law: Any smooth function expressible as infinite polynomial — bridge between discrete and continuous

Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.law: Differentiation and integration are inverse operations — the deepest theorem of calculus

Bayes' Theorem.name: Bayes' Theorem
Bayes' Theorem.law: How prior probability updates given new evidence — the Law of rational belief revision

Normal Distribution.name: Normal Distribution
Normal Distribution.law: The bell curve — emerges from the Central Limit Theorem as the universal distribution

Fourier Transform.name: Fourier Transform
Fourier Transform.law: Decomposes any signal into constituent frequencies — bridge between time and frequency domains

Euler-Lagrange Equation.name: Euler-Lagrange Equation
Euler-Lagrange Equation.law: Equations of motion from energy — the variational principle formulation of dynamics

Navier-Stokes Equation.name: Navier-Stokes Equation
Navier-Stokes Equation.law: Motion of viscous fluid — one of the Millennium Prize unsolved problems

Avogadro's Number.name: Avogadro's Number
Avogadro's Number.law: Number of particles in one mole — bridges microscopic and macroscopic scales

Arrhenius Equation.name: Arrhenius Equation
Arrhenius Equation.law: Temperature dependence of reaction rate — activation energy barrier

Henderson-Hasselbalch.name: Henderson-Hasselbalch
Henderson-Hasselbalch.law: pH of buffer solution — used in biochemistry to maintain biological pH

Beer-Lambert Law.name: Beer-Lambert Law
Beer-Lambert Law.law: Absorbance proportional to concentration — basis of spectrophotometry
